item.title: BSc student Haidar Chawki Kassem contributes to rainforest protection in Peru
item.description: A screenshot showing Radar for Detecting Deforestation (RADD) forest disturbance alerts in the Peruvian Amazon. Haidar Chawki Kassem, a graduated student from BSc FT Computer Science and AI, Queen Mary University of London, decided to undertake a research project based on developing a Google Earth Engine workflow that combines Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar (SAR) imagery with RADD forest disturbance alerts to classify the disturbance state of recently deforested sites in the Peruvian Amazon under the supervision of Dr Anna Xambó (QMUL) and Rory Hodgson (Rainforest Foundation UK).

item.title: Dr Anna Xambo at AI Soundscapes 2026
item.description: Anna Xambó giving a lecture-workshop. Photo by Jona Freigang. Anna was invited to give a lecture-workshop to explore creative AI applied to live coding and digital sampling at the AI-Soundscapes Congress organised by Zentrum Pop and hosted by Filmuniversität Babelsberg, Potsdam, Germany.
